# Statistics (I), Week 9: Continuous Probability Distributions (Part I)
# Interactive demonstrations for class
#   Tab 1: a histogram approaches a density curve as the bars get narrower
#   Tab 2: the shape and location of a normal distribution, given its mean and SD
#   Tab 3 (Week 10): areas under the standard normal curve
#   Tab 4 (Week 10): binomial bars versus the normal curve, with the continuity correction
#
# Run in R:  shiny::runApp("path/to/this/folder")   (needs the shiny package only)

library(shiny)

# Delivery-time example from the lecture notes: mean 25 minutes, SD 4 minutes
MU0 <- 25
SD0 <- 4

ui <- navbarPage(
  title = "Weeks 9-10: Continuous Distributions",

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Tab 1
  tabPanel(
    "From Bars to Areas",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        sliderInput("bw", "Bar width (minutes)",
                    min = 0.25, max = 6, value = 4, step = 0.25),
        sliderInput("n", "Number of orders recorded",
                    min = 100, max = 20000, value = 2000, step = 100),
        checkboxInput("show_curve", "Show the density curve", value = FALSE),
        sliderInput("ab", "Highlight orders between a and b (minutes)",
                    min = 10, max = 40, value = c(30, 40), step = 0.5),
        actionButton("resample", "Record a new sample"),
        hr(),
        helpText("Delivery times follow a normal distribution with mean 25",
                 "and SD 4 minutes. The vertical axis is relative frequency",
                 "divided by bar width, so the AREA of each bar is the",
                 "proportion of orders in that bar.")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        plotOutput("hist_plot", height = "430px"),
        tableOutput("area_table")
      )
    )
  ),

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Tab 2
  tabPanel(
    "The Normal Family",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        sliderInput("mu", HTML("Mean μ (location)"),
                    min = -30, max = 30, value = 0, step = 0.5),
        sliderInput("sigma", HTML("Standard deviation σ (scale)"),
                    min = 1, max = 10, value = 1, step = 0.5),
        radioButtons("band", "Shade the area within",
                     choices = c("None" = 0,
                                 "mu +/- 1 SD" = 1,
                                 "mu +/- 2 SD" = 2,
                                 "mu +/- 3 SD" = 3),
                     selected = 0),
        checkboxInput("show_ref", "Show the standard normal N(0, 1) for reference", value = TRUE),
        actionButton("reset", "Reset to the standard normal (mean 0, SD 1)"),
        hr(),
        helpText("Change the mean: the curve slides left or right.",
                 "Change the SD: the curve stretches or squeezes.",
                 "Because the total area is always 1, a wider curve must be lower.")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        plotOutput("normal_plot", height = "430px"),
        tableOutput("normal_table")
      )
    )
  ),

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Tab 3
  tabPanel(
    "Normal Areas",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        radioButtons("a_type", "Probability to find",
                     choices = c("P(z > a)" = "gt",
                                 "P(z < a)" = "lt",
                                 "P(a < z < b)" = "btw"),
                     selected = "gt"),
        sliderInput("a_a", "a", min = -3.5, max = 3.5, value = 1.25, step = 0.01),
        conditionalPanel("input.a_type == 'btw'",
                         sliderInput("a_b", "b", min = -3.5, max = 3.5, value = 2, step = 0.01)),
        hr(),
        helpText("Standard normal distribution: mean 0, SD 1.",
                 "The table gives the area between 0 and a positive z.",
                 "For a negative z, drop the minus sign (the curve is symmetric),",
                 "then add or subtract with 0.5 as the picture suggests.")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        plotOutput("area_plot", height = "430px"),
        tableOutput("area_steps")
      )
    )
  ),

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Tab 4
  tabPanel(
    "Binomial vs Normal",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        sliderInput("b_n", "Number of trials n",
                    min = 5, max = 300, value = 50, step = 1),
        sliderInput("b_pi", HTML("Probability of success π"),
                    min = 0.01, max = 0.99, value = 0.5, step = 0.01),
        checkboxInput("b_curve", "Show the normal curve with the same mean and SD", value = TRUE),
        hr(),
        radioButtons("b_type", "Question",
                     choices = c("At least k   (X >= k)" = "ge",
                                 "More than k  (X > k)" = "gt",
                                 "At most k    (X <= k)" = "le",
                                 "Fewer than k (X < k)" = "lt",
                                 "Exactly k    (X = k)" = "eq"),
                     selected = "ge"),
        sliderInput("b_k", "k", min = 0, max = 50, value = 30, step = 1),
        hr(),
        helpText("Try pi = 0.02 or pi = 0.98 with n = 50: the bars pile up",
                 "against one end and the bell no longer fits.",
                 "Then raise n and watch the fit improve.")
      ),
      mainPanel(
        plotOutput("binom_plot", height = "430px"),
        tableOutput("binom_table")
      )
    )
  )

)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Tab 1 logic
  sample_data <- reactive({
    input$resample                     # re-run when the button is pressed
    rnorm(input$n, mean = MU0, sd = SD0)
  })

  hist_obj <- reactive({
    x  <- sample_data()
    bw <- input$bw
    # Bar edges anchored at the mean, wide enough to cover every observation
    k_lo <- floor((min(x) - MU0) / bw) - 1
    k_hi <- ceiling((max(x) - MU0) / bw) + 1
    brks <- MU0 + bw * (k_lo:k_hi)
    hist(x, breaks = brks, plot = FALSE)
  })

  output$hist_plot <- renderPlot({
    h  <- hist_obj()
    a  <- input$ab[1]
    b  <- input$ab[2]
    left  <- head(h$breaks, -1)
    right <- tail(h$breaks, -1)
    inside <- h$mids >= a & h$mids <= b

    par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 2, 1))
    plot(NA, xlim = c(5, 45), ylim = c(0, 0.13),
         xlab = "Delivery time (minutes)",
         ylab = "Relative frequency / bar width",
         main = paste0("Bar width = ", input$bw, " minutes,  n = ", input$n))
    rect(left, 0, right, h$density,
         col = ifelse(inside, "#F4A261", "#CFE1F2"), border = "grey40")
    abline(v = c(a, b), lty = 2, col = "#E76F51", lwd = 1.5)

    if (input$show_curve) {
      curve(dnorm(x, MU0, SD0), from = 5, to = 45, n = 400,
            add = TRUE, lwd = 3, col = "#1D3557")
    }
    legend("topright", bty = "n",
           legend = c("Bars inside [a, b]", "Other bars",
                      if (input$show_curve) "Density curve"),
           fill = c("#F4A261", "#CFE1F2", if (input$show_curve) NA),
           border = c("grey40", "grey40", if (input$show_curve) NA),
           lwd = c(NA, NA, if (input$show_curve) 3),
           col = c(NA, NA, if (input$show_curve) "#1D3557"))
  })

  output$area_table <- renderTable({
    x <- sample_data()
    h <- hist_obj()
    a <- input$ab[1]
    b <- input$ab[2]
    data.frame(
      Quantity = c("Total area of all bars",
                   paste0("Proportion of recorded orders between ", a, " and ", b),
                   paste0("Area under the curve between ", a, " and ", b)),
      Value = c(sprintf("%.4f", sum(h$density * diff(h$breaks))),
                sprintf("%.4f", mean(x > a & x < b)),
                sprintf("%.4f", pnorm(b, MU0, SD0) - pnorm(a, MU0, SD0)))
    )
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Tab 2 logic
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    updateSliderInput(session, "mu", value = 0)
    updateSliderInput(session, "sigma", value = 1)
  })

  output$normal_plot <- renderPlot({
    mu <- input$mu
    s  <- input$sigma
    k  <- as.numeric(input$band)
    xs <- seq(-90, 90, length.out = 2000)

    par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 2, 1))
    plot(NA, xlim = c(-60, 60), ylim = c(0, 0.42),
         xlab = "x", ylab = "Density",
         main = sprintf("Normal distribution with mean %.1f and SD %.1f", mu, s))

    if (k > 0) {
      xx <- seq(mu - k * s, mu + k * s, length.out = 400)
      polygon(c(xx, rev(xx)), c(dnorm(xx, mu, s), rep(0, length(xx))),
              col = "#F4A26199", border = NA)
      pct <- 100 * (pnorm(k) - pnorm(-k))
      text(mu, dnorm(mu, mu, s) * 0.45,
           sprintf("%.1f%%", pct), cex = 1.4, font = 2)
      abline(v = mu + c(-k, k) * s, lty = 3, col = "#E76F51")
    }
    if (input$show_ref) {
      lines(xs, dnorm(xs, 0, 1), lty = 2, lwd = 2, col = "grey55")
    }
    lines(xs, dnorm(xs, mu, s), lwd = 3, col = "#1D3557")
    segments(mu, 0, mu, dnorm(mu, mu, s), lty = 2, col = "#1D3557")
    mtext(expression(mu), side = 1, at = mu, line = 0.3, col = "#1D3557")

    legend("topright", bty = "n",
           legend = c("Your curve", if (input$show_ref) "Standard normal N(0, 1)"),
           lwd = c(3, if (input$show_ref) 2),
           lty = c(1, if (input$show_ref) 2),
           col = c("#1D3557", if (input$show_ref) "grey55"))
  })

  output$normal_table <- renderTable({
    mu <- input$mu
    s  <- input$sigma
    data.frame(
      Quantity = c("Mean = median = mode",
                   "Peak height = 1 / (sigma * sqrt(2 pi))",
                   "About 68% of values lie between",
                   "About 95% of values lie between",
                   "Practically all (99.7%) lie between",
                   "Total area under the curve"),
      Value = c(sprintf("%.1f", mu),
                sprintf("%.4f", dnorm(mu, mu, s)),
                sprintf("%.1f and %.1f", mu - s, mu + s),
                sprintf("%.1f and %.1f", mu - 2 * s, mu + 2 * s),
                sprintf("%.1f and %.1f", mu - 3 * s, mu + 3 * s),
                "1")
    )
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Tab 3 logic
  area_calc <- reactive({
    a  <- input$a_a
    b  <- if (is.null(input$a_b)) a else input$a_b
    lo <- min(a, b)
    hi <- max(a, b)
    rng <- switch(input$a_type,
                  gt  = c(a, Inf),
                  lt  = c(-Inf, a),
                  btw = c(lo, hi))
    list(a = a, lo = lo, hi = hi, rng = rng, prob = pnorm(rng[2]) - pnorm(rng[1]))
  })

  output$area_plot <- renderPlot({
    v  <- area_calc()
    xs <- seq(-4, 4, length.out = 800)

    par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 2.5, 1))
    plot(NA, xlim = c(-4, 4), ylim = c(0, 0.45),
         xlab = "z", ylab = "Density", xaxt = "n",
         main = sprintf("Probability = %.4f", v$prob))
    axis(1, at = -4:4)
    shade <- function(from, to) {
      from <- max(from, -4)
      to   <- min(to, 4)
      if (to > from) {
        xx <- seq(from, to, length.out = 400)
        polygon(c(xx, rev(xx)), c(dnorm(xx), rep(0, length(xx))),
                col = "#F4A261CC", border = NA)
      }
    }
    shade(v$rng[1], v$rng[2])
    lines(xs, dnorm(xs), lwd = 3, col = "#1D3557")
    segments(0, 0, 0, dnorm(0), lty = 3, col = "grey40")

    cuts <- if (input$a_type == "btw") c(v$lo, v$hi) else v$a
    abline(v = cuts, lty = 2, col = "#E76F51", lwd = 1.5)
    mtext(sprintf("%.2f", cuts), side = 3, at = cuts, line = 0.2,
          col = "#E76F51", cex = 0.9)
  })

  output$area_steps <- renderTable({
    v <- area_calc()
    A <- function(z) pnorm(abs(z)) - 0.5      # table area between 0 and |z|
    if (input$a_type == "btw") {
      data.frame(
        Step = c(sprintf("Area between 0 and %.2f (table)", v$lo),
                 sprintf("Area between 0 and %.2f (table)", v$hi),
                 "Probability"),
        Value = c(sprintf("%.4f", A(v$lo)), sprintf("%.4f", A(v$hi)),
                  sprintf("%.4f", v$prob)))
    } else {
      data.frame(
        Step = c(sprintf("Area between 0 and %.2f (table)", v$a), "Probability"),
        Value = c(sprintf("%.4f", A(v$a)), sprintf("%.4f", v$prob)))
    }
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Tab 4 logic
  observeEvent(input$b_n, {
    k <- min(input$b_k, input$b_n)
    updateSliderInput(session, "b_k", max = input$b_n, value = k)
  })

  binom_calc <- reactive({
    n  <- input$b_n
    p  <- input$b_pi
    k  <- min(input$b_k, n)
    mu <- n * p
    s  <- sqrt(n * p * (1 - p))
    x  <- 0:n
    inc <- switch(input$b_type,
                  ge = x >= k, gt = x > k, le = x <= k, lt = x < k, eq = x == k)
    cut <- switch(input$b_type,
                  ge = c(k - 0.5, Inf), gt = c(k + 0.5, Inf),
                  le = c(-Inf, k + 0.5), lt = c(-Inf, k - 0.5),
                  eq = c(k - 0.5, k + 0.5))
    exact  <- sum(dbinom(x[inc], n, p))
    approx <- pnorm(cut[2], mu, s) - pnorm(cut[1], mu, s)
    list(n = n, p = p, k = k, mu = mu, s = s, x = x, inc = inc,
         cut = cut, exact = exact, approx = approx)
  })

  output$binom_plot <- renderPlot({
    v  <- binom_calc()
    lo <- max(0, floor(v$mu - 4.5 * v$s) - 1)
    hi <- min(v$n, ceiling(v$mu + 4.5 * v$s) + 1)
    lo <- min(lo, v$k)
    hi <- max(hi, v$k)
    xs <- lo:hi
    px <- dbinom(xs, v$n, v$p)
    ymax <- max(px, dnorm(v$mu, v$mu, v$s)) * 1.15

    par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 2.5, 1))
    plot(NA, xlim = c(lo - 1, hi + 1), ylim = c(0, ymax),
         xlab = "Number of successes x", ylab = "Probability",
         main = sprintf("Binomial(n = %d, pi = %.2f):  n*pi = %.1f,  n(1 - pi) = %.1f",
                        v$n, v$p, v$mu, v$n - v$mu))
    rect(xs - 0.45, 0, xs + 0.45, px,
         col = ifelse(v$inc[xs + 1], "#2A6FDB99", "#F4A26199"), border = "grey40")
    if (input$b_curve && v$s > 0) {
      cx <- seq(lo - 1, hi + 1, length.out = 600)
      lines(cx, dnorm(cx, v$mu, v$s), lwd = 3, col = "#C1121F")
    }
    cuts <- v$cut[is.finite(v$cut)]
    abline(v = cuts, lty = 2, lwd = 2, col = "#1D3557")
    mtext(format(cuts), side = 3, at = cuts, line = 0.1, col = "#1D3557", cex = 0.9)
    legend("topright", bty = "n",
           legend = c("Bars included", "Other bars",
                      if (input$b_curve) "Normal curve",
                      "Cutoff with continuity correction"),
           fill = c("#2A6FDB99", "#F4A26199", if (input$b_curve) NA, NA),
           border = c("grey40", "grey40", if (input$b_curve) NA, NA),
           lwd = c(NA, NA, if (input$b_curve) 3, 2),
           lty = c(NA, NA, if (input$b_curve) 1, 2),
           col = c(NA, NA, if (input$b_curve) "#C1121F", "#1D3557"))
  })

  output$binom_table <- renderTable({
    v  <- binom_calc()
    ok <- v$mu >= 5 && (v$n - v$mu) >= 5
    data.frame(
      Quantity = c("n * pi and n(1 - pi)",
                   "Normal approximation appropriate? (both at least 5)",
                   "Normal curve: mean n*pi, SD sqrt(n pi (1 - pi))",
                   "Exact binomial probability",
                   "Normal approximation (with continuity correction)",
                   "Difference"),
      Value = c(sprintf("%.2f and %.2f", v$mu, v$n - v$mu),
                if (ok) "Yes" else "No: the binomial is too skewed",
                sprintf("mean %.2f, SD %.3f", v$mu, v$s),
                sprintf("%.4f", v$exact),
                sprintf("%.4f", v$approx),
                sprintf("%.4f", v$approx - v$exact))
    )
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
